SIKALASTIC®-888: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sikalastic®-888, February 2026, Version 01.03 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikalastic-888.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sikalastic®-888 where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2026, Version 01.03).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sikalastic®-888 is a two component, solvent free, flexible polyurea membrane system with good chemical resistance properties.
    - Sikalastic®-888 is 100% solids and has been formulated to be spray applied using plural component spray equipment.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Sikalastic®-888 is ideal for the following applications:
    - Bridge deck waterproofing membrane
    - Abrasion resistant protective coating in industrial and manufacturing facilities
    - Waterproofing for cut and cover structures
    - Waterproofing for submersed structures
    - Waterproofing on walkways and balconies
    - Waterproofing on floors and car park decks
    - Water retaining structures in power plants
    - Secondary containment structures Tank, bund and pit lining in sewage and waste water treatment plants
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.5.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sikalastic®-888
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Two component solvent free 100% solids pure Polyurea
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Certificates and test reports. AS/ NZS 4020:2018 Potable water approved
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS/ NZS 4020:2018: listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1).
    - AS1683.15: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Shore A hardness (p.2); Product Information > Shore D Hardness (p.2).
    - AS1683.11: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - AS1683.12: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Tear strength (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Very fast reactivity and curing time
    - Almost immediate return-to-service time
    - Applicable in temperatures from +1°C to +50°C
    - Performs in constant dry temperatures from -30°C to +100°C
    - Excellent crack bridging properties
    - Good chemical resistance
    - Excellent abrasion resistance
    - Can be applied on polystyrene/ polyurethane foams
    - Not resistant to biogenic sulphuric acid
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Pure Polyurea
    - Colour: Grey; White (MTO); Blue (MTO)
    - Density: Part A: 1.13kg @ 40°C; Part B: 1.0kg @ 40°C
    - Viscosity: Part A: 180 (cps @ 40°C); Part B: 150 (cps @ 40°C)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Shore A hardness: 95 (AS1683.15)
    - Shore D Hardness: 45 ~ 50 (AS1683.15)
    - Tensile strength: 17.0MPa (AS1683.11)
    - Tear strength: 75 kN/m (AS1683.12- Angle tear strength)
    - Service temperature: -30°C to +100°C
2.7 System structure. CONCRETE SUBSTRATE APPLICATIONS:
    - Sikalastic 100 EP Primer must be used as the primer for potable water applications.
    - If Sikalastic 100 EP Primer/Sikafloor 160 is being overcoated with Sikalastic®-888 within 24 hours of application, sand broadcasting is not required.
    - Please note for substrates containing moisture (up to 6%) we suggest substituting primer for Sikalastic Moisture Seal.
    - For adhesion to other substrates than concrete please contact Sika Technical for advice.
    | Coating System | Product | Consumption |
    | Primer Coat | Sikalastic 100 EP | 0.2 - 0.4kg/m² (depend- |
    | Primer/Sikafloor 160 | ing on substrate poros- |
    | (epoxy primer) | ity) |
    | Primer Broadcast | 0.3-0.8mm kiln dried | 1.0-1.5kg/m² |

2.8 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Part A: 210kg drum; Part B: 200kg drum
    - Shelf life: 12 months from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The packaging must be stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging, in dry and cool conditions protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (February 2026, Version 01.03) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (February 2026, Version 01.03) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: Part A : Part B= 1:1 volume
    - Consumption: approx. 1.033 kg/m²/mm
    - Layer thickness: > 2 mm (Crucial System); ≥ 1.5 mm (Standard System)
    - Curing time: 24 hours @ +20°C
    - Waiting time to overcoating: 1 to 2min @ +20°C
    - Drying time: <5 seconds (Gel time)
4.3 Mixing. Dose and mix with a suitable air driven or electrical plural component heated spray equipment. Both components must be heated up to +60 °C. The accuracy of mixing and dosage must be controlled regularly with the equipment. Thoroughly stir part B (Amine) using a drum stirrer until a homogenous colour is obtained.
4.4 Cleaning of equipment. Clean all tools with Thinner C immediately after use. The application equipment has to cleaned and filled with Mesamoll. Hardened and/or cured material can only be removed mechanically.
4.5 Limitations and important considerations.
    - This product may only be used by experienced professionals.
    - For spray application the use of protective health and safety equipment is mandatory.
    - The maximum layer thickness per application pass shall not exceed 4mm, for the build-up of higher thicknesses several passes have to be applied.
    - UV light exposure will lead to yellowing and chalking, Sikalastic 888 is not UV stable.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. -20°C ~ +50°C
5.3 Relative air humidity. < 85%
5.4 Substrate temperature. +1°C ~ +50°C; ≥ 3°C above dew point, beware of condensation
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sikalastic®-888, February 2026, Version 01.03, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/g/sikalastic-888.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalastic 888 Part A, version 10/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/5/Sikalastic%20888%20Part%20A.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: Sikalastic-888 Part B, version 10/11/2022, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/Sikalastic%20888%20Part%20B.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-888 Part A, version 08/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sds-sikalastic-888parta.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS Sikalastic®-888 Part B, version 08/01/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/3/sds-sikalastic-888partb.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
